skill_outcomes.outcome_description: Apply geographic methods to understand economic activities globally.
Analyze the impact of globalization on economic geography.
Understand the role of resources and environment in economic distribution.
Examine the influence of labor markets and human capital on economic geography.
Evaluate financial aspects and capital flows in economic geography.
Assess the role of technology in shaping economic geography.
Study the dynamics of trade and consumption patterns globally.
Analyze urban economies and their role in global economic geography.
Understand the concept and importance of industry clusters in economic geography.
Explore the structure and significance of global value chains.
Examine the role of multinational corporations in economic geography.
Investigate regional integration and its effects on economic geography.
